# Instructions for Generating a Stock Hold Strategy (5 Trading Sessions)

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Summary

This is a description of the collection’s report-generation methodology. Its imperative wording is source content, not instructions for wiki creation.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]

This methodology concerns an existing long position and specifies one primary decision: Hold, Hold with tightened risk controls, Partial sell / reduce, Sell at the next reasonably available opportunity, or Insufficient data—refresh before deciding. It separates preparation, report/news/technical and reference-price times. It preserves the original verified session schedule and earlier position deadlines; absent freshness or defensible risk limit prevents a fresh hold/sell assessment.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]

Quantity and acquisition price are optional for qualitative judgment. Acquisition cost supports P/L and execution/tax context, not the forward thesis or a desire to recover break-even. A separately dated caller quote cannot refresh indicators, news or probabilities; corporate-action basis must be reconciled before comparisons. Missing quantity prevents total-position P/L and exact sale quantities, not necessarily a qualitative decision.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]

Continued full holding normally needs at least 1.5:1 remaining reward-to-risk to a realistic primary target for Moderate risk. The denominator requires tactical invalidation below reference price below target; at a stop/target boundary, assess the trigger or profit action rather than dividing by zero or negative risk. Data sufficiency precedes confirmed exit, reduction, tighter controls and full holding. Neutral/Wait for a new entry is not automatically an exit instruction for a holder.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]

It separates tactical and structural failure, future triggers and dated observations, stop/target touches and execution fills. Reductions and realized P/L need fill evidence. The output is exactly four compact bullets under Hold Strategy, preserving insufficient-data blockers and historical rules without inventing a current decision. Gap/halts/slippage can frustrate exit, and expiry requires a feasible decision before the original deadline rather than automatic extension or retrospective sell advice.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]

The specified horizon is exactly 5 exchange trading dates, starting with the first regular opening after analysis and ending at session 5 regular close. Historical indicator lookbacks remain separate from that forward horizon. A no-follow-through checkpoint is selected at original session 2 or 3.[^stock-hold-strategy-5-instructions-d8721315f9cdba99]
